## Contract and outcomes

read returns the engine Snapshot; it is a readback, not a second writable document. Supply a PrepareRequest to can or commit. Rust prepare/commit validates the request and returns CommitResult; inspect that result before reporting success. Re-read the committed snapshot for rendered content.

## Errors and recovery

Read-only, stale targets, unsupported operations and permissions can reject work. Do not retry against a guessed range or overwrite a newer snapshot. Capture a fresh authorized target and preserve rejected source.

## Prerequisites and platform limits

Only admitted schema/profile operations are valid. DOM edits and fabricated snapshots are not a public mutation API.
